current_flow: actuals-loader adds POST /api/ingest/actuals (a new backend/src/ingest module, guarded by AuthGuard + a new 'ingest' grant seeded to admin, in the route allow-list): a multipart .xlsx is parsed by header set from the SAP Report sheet, every row validated before any write (single period from Posting Date), Actual netted as Debit-Credit at paise, DUB-NUR normalized to DUB (plant + plant_src kept), line_id = Line_Id || the '#' row number, and the whole source row stored in a new raw jsonb column; the ingest service then calls the REUSED IngestionRepository.replaceActualsBatch once with full uploader metadata, making a new active ingest_batch and retaining the prior. One additive warehouse migration (the raw column); no read-port change, no budget join, no allocation (0004/0014).
new_abstractions: the backend/src/ingest module (guarded multipart controller + service)
the SAP actuals header-identified parser (paise netting, single-period, Line_Id||# identity)
the 'ingest' RBAC action grant seeded to admin
the additive raw jsonb column + migration on sap_transaction

criteria_map.POST /api/ingest/actuals is guarded by A: KEEP. POST /api/ingest/actuals guarded by AuthGuard + a NEW 'ingest' grant (added to GRANT_ACTIONS AND seeded to admin in db/migrate.ts baseRolePerms so it is obtainable), added to the app.routes.test.ts allow-list, typed multipart DTO (field 'file', 15MB/25k-row caps, 413), raw typed response matching saved/pins, CSRF + forbidden tests (findings 6,8,9).
criteria_map.the loader identifies the sheet by its r: KEEP (amended). Sheet identified by its required HEADER set (dup 'Comments' + blank leads tolerated); the single period is derived from Posting Date (the 'Month' cell is only 'Jul' - display only); ALL rows validated before ANY write; invalid/mixed-period -> row-level diagnostics {row,column,message}[] with NO write (findings 3,8).
criteria_map.each row nets Actual = Debit - Credit at: KEEP (amended). Actual = Debit - Credit at paise numeric(18,2) strings; DUB-NUR->DUB documented constant (accept all other plants, no allow-list per 0014); plant + plant_src both retained; line_id = Line_Id || the '#' row number (298 blank-Line_Id rows); the FULL raw row retained in a new 'raw' jsonb column (additive migration) - all source+drill fields kept (findings 1,2,4,5).
criteria_map.a re-upload of a period is idempotent: a: KEEP. A re-upload makes a NEW active ingest_batch and RETAINS the prior; replaceActualsBatch is called once with full metadata (uploadedBy/validationResult/reconciliationResult) + pool lifecycle; 'no duplicate rows' = unique within a batch via UNIQUE(batch_id,txn_no,line_id) (findings 7,12).

gaps: The SAP Report has 298 blank Line_Id values (incl. 6 DUB-NUR) while sap_transaction.line_id is NOT NULL and part of the per-batch unique key - the full July load cannot be represented
The story requires all source + drill fields retained (ShortName, both Comments, Origin, Loc.) but sap_transaction has nowhere to persist them
Period validation was underspecified: the Month cell is only 'Jul' yet the period must be 2026-07-01; mixed years could be accepted
'Known plant' validation conflicts with no-master/full-batch: 31 plants, only DUB-NUR has a rule, and there is no catalogue to validate against
The mapping was claimed to come from Sheet1 but the plan implements a hard-coded constant with no read/validate mechanism
Changing only GRANT_ACTIONS seeds no role the 'ingest' grant (db/migrate.ts baseRolePerms), so the grant is unobtainable after a normal migrate
The writer contract was incomplete: replaceActualsBatch also needs uploadedBy/validationResult/reconciliationResult and the createWarehouseDb(pool)/pool lifecycle
The multipart contract omitted the form-field name, file count, byte/row caps, limit-error status, and a safe row-diagnostic shape
The planned raw success body contradicted the codebase's response convention and the diagnostics were disconnected from the global error envelope
The evidence plan did not prove the service boundary (validate-all-before-write, uploader metadata, exactly one repository call) and left the gated DB test unnamed
Adding exceljs changes root package-lock.json, which was absent from write_scope, so npm ci would not install it
'No duplicate rows' had no scope - re-upload intentionally retains the prior batch so rows repeat across batches
resolutions: HUMAN-decided: line_id = SAP Line_Id when present, else the SAP '#' row number (a unique immutable source identity) - keeps NOT NULL + UNIQUE and lets the full 4,113-line July load succeed; no nullable schema change.

HUMAN-decided: add a 'raw' jsonb column to sap_transaction via a NEW additive migration (backend/drizzle-warehouse/0001_*.sql) storing the whole source row; warehouse-schema.ts + its hermetic test extended; read-only port untouched.
Period = first-of-month derived from Posting Date; every row must match the single period; the 'Month' token is validated for consistency but never parsed for the period.
Accept every nonblank source plant unchanged EXCEPT DUB-NUR -> DUB; no catalogue/allow-list (0014 no-master).
DUB-NUR -> DUB is a single documented constant in plant-mapping.ts (the only nursery rule); the full Sheet1 mapping belongs to governed-joins, out of scope here.
Seed { role: 'admin', action: 'ingest' } in db/migrate.ts baseRolePerms (write_scope +) so the grant is obtainable after a normal migrate.

Specified full CandidateBatchMetadata (period, uploadedBy = authenticated app-user id, validationResult = the row/period validation summary, reconciliationResult = {}) and the createWarehouseWritePool -> createWarehouseDb -> IngestionRepository -> pool.end lifecycle.

Specified: field name 'file', exactly one .xlsx, 15MB byte cap + 25,000 row cap, 413 on exceed, and sanitized {row, column, message}[] diagnostics carried by the global constitution-07 error envelope.
Return a raw typed IngestActualsResponse (matches saved/pins - there is NO success-envelope wrapper here); diagnostics flow through the existing global error envelope.

Added ingest.service.test.ts (validate every row before any write, NO repository call on invalid, exactly ONE replaceActualsBatch with uploader metadata - repository mocked) and named the WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1-gated DB proof (ingest.service.test.ts, one suite, host command).
Added package-lock.json to write_scope so the exceljs dependency reproduces under npm ci.
'No duplicate rows' scoped to unique WITHIN a batch (UNIQUE(batch_id,txn_no,line_id) + whole-file-per-period grain); across batches rows intentionally repeat (retention).

summary: One cold read returned twelve findings. Ten are repository/story-answerable and resolved in the amended contract + plan (period from Posting Date, accept-all-plants with a DUB-NUR->DUB constant, seed the 'ingest' grant to admin, full writer metadata + pool lifecycle, concrete multipart limits + 413, raw typed response matching saved/pins, an added service test + a named gated DB proof, package-lock.json in scope, and unique-within-a-batch dedup). The two genuine product decisions went to the human, who chose to add a raw jsonb column for full-fidelity retention and to use the SAP '#' row number as the source identity for the 298 blank-Line_Id rows. Verdict pass.
